purpose: Phase-7C adaptive-immunity structure: CD8 cytotoxic T cells, CD4 helper T cells, regulatory T cells (Treg). Each cell type separates availability / recruitment-infiltration / activation / competence / suppression from net contribution; CD8 additionally separates priming, exhaustion, and recovery potential. Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no T-cell count / TCR / clonality (NOT_REPORTED; excluded).

coefficient_policy.source: general adaptive tumour-immunology biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: CD8 exhaustion consumes checkpoint pressure once; the final suppression score must not re-add the identical checkpoint term (double-counting guard).
coefficient_policy.limitations: No T-cell count / TCR sequence / clonality / neoantigen prediction (all NOT_REPORTED / excluded).

double_counting_rules.checkpoint_once: PD-1/PD-L1 axis pressure enters CD8 exhaustion once; it is not re-applied unchanged in total immune suppression.
double_counting_rules.treg_decomposed: Treg suppressive pressure is a named component of total immune suppression, not duplicated as an anonymous suppression term.
